terms.label: Collection
terms.comment: A meaningful collection of concepts.

terms.label: Concept
terms.comment: An idea or notion; a unit of thought.

terms.label: Concept Scheme
terms.comment: A set of concepts, optionally including statements about semantic relationships between those concepts.

terms.label: Ordered Collection
terms.comment: An ordered collection of concepts, where both the grouping and the ordering are meaningful.

terms.label: alternative label
terms.comment: The range of skos:altLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.

terms.label: has broader match
terms.comment: skos:broadMatch is used to state a hierarchical mapping link between two conceptual resources in different concept schemes.

terms.label: has broader
terms.comment: Broader concepts are typically rendered as parents in a concept hierarchy (tree).

terms.label: has broader transitive
terms.comment: skos:broaderTransitive is a transitive superproperty of skos:broader.

terms.label: change note
terms.comment: A note about a modification to a concept.

terms.label: has close match
terms.comment: skos:closeMatch is used to link two concepts that are sufficiently similar that they can be used interchangeably in some information retrieval applications. In order to avoid the possibility of "compound errors" when combining mappings across more than two concept schemes, skos:closeMatch is not declared to be a transitive property.

terms.label: definition
terms.comment: A statement or formal explanation of the meaning of a concept.

terms.label: editorial note
terms.comment: A note for an editor, translator or maintainer of the vocabulary.

terms.label: has exact match
terms.comment: skos:exactMatch is disjoint with each of the properties skos:broadMatch and skos:relatedMatch.

terms.label: example
terms.comment: An example of the use of a concept.

terms.label: has top concept
terms.comment: Relates, by convention, a concept scheme to a concept which is topmost in the broader/narrower concept hierarchies for that scheme, providing an entry point to these hierarchies.

terms.label: hidden label
terms.comment: The range of skos:hiddenLabel is the class of RDF plain literals.

terms.label: history note
terms.comment: A note about the past state/use/meaning of a concept.

terms.label: is in scheme
terms.comment: Relates a resource (for example a concept) to a concept scheme in which it is included.

terms.label: is in mapping relation with
terms.comment: These concept mapping relations mirror semantic relations, and the data model defined below is similar (with the exception of skos:exactMatch) to the data model defined for semantic relations. A distinct vocabulary is provided for concept mapping relations, to provide a convenient way to differentiate links within a concept scheme from links between concept schemes. However, this pattern of usage is not a formal requirement of the SKOS data model, and relies on informal definitions of best prac…

terms.label: has member
terms.comment: Relates a collection to one of its members.

terms.label: has member list
terms.comment: For any resource, every item in the list given as the value of the skos:memberList property is also a value of the skos:member property.

terms.label: has narrower match
terms.comment: skos:narrowMatch is used to state a hierarchical mapping link between two conceptual resources in different concept schemes.

terms.label: has narrower
terms.comment: Narrower concepts are typically rendered as children in a concept hierarchy (tree).

terms.label: has narrower transitive
terms.comment: skos:narrowerTransitive is a transitive superproperty of skos:narrower.

terms.label: notation
terms.comment: A notation, also known as classification code, is a string of characters such as "T58.5" or "303.4833" used to uniquely identify a concept within the scope of a given concept scheme.

terms.label: note
terms.comment: A general note, for any purpose.

terms.label: preferred label
terms.comment: A resource has no more than one value of skos:prefLabel per language tag, and no more than one value of skos:prefLabel without language tag.

terms.label: has related
terms.comment: skos:related is disjoint with skos:broaderTransitive

terms.label: has related match
terms.comment: skos:relatedMatch is used to state an associative mapping link between two conceptual resources in different concept schemes.

terms.label: scope note
terms.comment: A note that helps to clarify the meaning and/or the use of a concept.

terms.label: is in semantic relation with
terms.comment: Links a concept to a concept related by meaning.

terms.label: is top concept in scheme
terms.comment: Relates a concept to the concept scheme that it is a top level concept of.
